`--expected` is the job's current `notice_digest` from `notices` (`read` returns
no `notice_digest`). No CLI command removes or rewrites `release.json`, so a
release cannot be undone; a released job also gains no delivery authority
(`delivery-claim` and an absent `delivery-recover` both refuse it).
The evaluator completes its own claim; FO checks the actual resulting record.
No-change ends with a local notice and creates no branch or PR.

## Prepare a changed proposal

For a completed result with changes, delegate materialization into an owned
isolated Git worktree from the explicitly selected integration branch. Use the
job-derived branch `learning/JOB` and keep root `learning.md` as the sole proposed
changed file. Preserve unrelated text and apply exactly the approved add/remove
proposal; do not introduce a new Markdown parser, rewrite project conventions,
edit AGENTS.md or add a score system. A rewrite remains remove plus add.

Require the plan's source base commit and learning.md blob (`absent` when missing)
to match the evaluated pack's pinned learning basis. Recheck
that source against current integration history before publication. Drift,
conflicting concurrent proposals or an already-applied change requires review;
do not silently rebase, widen or overwrite. Inspect any existing worktree/branch
before reuse and hold if ownership is unknown. Reuse a matching prior candidate;
do not replace successful evaluator records to make a changed plan fit.

Present the exact learning.md diff and proposed commit; preserve the user's
commit approval policy and stage only that file. After approved commit, prepare
the exact Draft PR title/body and candidate SHA. Include the single body marker
`<!-- kc-dev-flow-2 learning JOB -->`. Present them for push/PR authority, reusing
an applicable explicit standing grant. Learning evaluation or task closure does
not grant delivery authority. Do not auto-merge or fall back to a local merge.

Before publication, query the explicit repository for that branch across **all**
PR states (`gh pr list --repo OWNER_REPO --head BRANCH --state all --json number,url,state,body,headRefName,headRefOid,baseRefName,isDraft,mergedAt,mergeCommit`).
Validate repository, job marker, branch, source candidate and base against the
reviewed plan; check the chosen PR directly too. Multiple matches, mismatches or
an unavailable query hold. An existing matching PR is reused, not recreated.

## Record before remote effects

Use the fixed plan/observation shapes below. `delivery-claim` requires a completed
changed result and its digest, returns a delivery token once, and durably records
uncertainty before any push/create. An existing or torn delivery record yields no
new send authority. These local ownership checks do not prove provider facts or
substitute for the explicit user grant.

```sh
python3 <package>/scripts/learning.py --repo "$CODE_ROOT" delivery-claim --job JOB --owner SESSION --plan plan.json
python3 <package>/scripts/learning.py --repo "$CODE_ROOT" delivery-record --job JOB --token DELIVERY_TOKEN --observation observation.json
```

On a new claim with authority and a confirmed absent PR, push the exact approved
candidate to the bound branch (no force), then create using `gh pr create --draft`
with explicit repo/base/head/title and a body file containing the plan's exact
body bytes. Verify the resulting PR binding and Draft state, then record it.
Do not interpret a timeout or failed client response as proof that nothing was
sent. Keep the uncertainty and reconcile; never blindly repeat push/create.
For an existing match, record/reuse the observed PR and perform no new send;
a PR already marked ready can be observed without claiming this run created it
as Draft. The recorder validates bindings, not the historical creation ceremony.

The plan has exactly: `schema_version: 1`, `result_digest` (the completed result's
`read.digest`), lowercase `repository` (`owner/repo`), `branch` (`learning/JOB`),
`marker` (the exact marker above), `base_branch`, `base_commit`, `candidate_commit`,
`source_learning_blob` (OID or `absent`), `candidate_learning_blob` (OID), absolute
`worktree`, `title`, and `body` (the reviewed UTF-8 text, including marker once).
The CLI binds these supplied identities; FO verifies actual Git/file bytes.

An observation has exactly `state` (`open`, `merged`, `closed`, `absent`, `unknown`),
`repository`, `branch`, `candidate_commit`, `marker`, `pr` (`owner/repo#N` or null),
`merge_commit` (OID for merged, otherwise null), `draft` (boolean for a known PR,
otherwise null), and nonempty `evidence` (references to the actual provider reads).
The four identity fields match the plan. Missing provider evidence is unknown,
not absent; only a successful all-state lookup supports absent. An observed PR
cannot be forgotten/replaced, and merged delivery cannot regress through the CLI.

After verifying the old owner stopped, reconcile provider state and use
`delivery-recover --job JOB --expected DELIVERY_DIGEST --owner-state stopped
--reason REASON --plan plan.json --observation observation.json --owner SESSION`.
Get the delivery digest from `notices --all`, which also exposes acknowledged
jobs for explicit inspection. Recovery archives prior bytes, invalidates
old tokens and refuses stale snapshots. A matching observed PR is recorded/reused;
only a confirmed absent lookup returns new send eligibility. Unknown observations
hold. Recheck delivery authority before any retry. A merged observation is a
caller-recorded fact, not a mechanical GitHub check or a grant to use a PR branch.
Subsequent work reads the currently adopted integration version of learning.md;
pending or closed-unmerged proposals are not active practices.

If the delivery token itself is lost while its owner is still the running
session — not an owner-stopped recovery — do not attest `--owner-state stopped`;
that would be false. Call `delivery-recover` with the identical `--owner` used at
`delivery-claim`, an honest `--owner-state running` or `unknown`, and a freshly
confirmed-absent observation. The CLI accepts this reissue only when the delivery
still has no recorded observation (nothing was sent under the lost token); a
different owner, or any existing observation (open, merged or otherwise), still
requires a genuine stopped attestation. If instead the delivery was already sent
by hand under the lost token — an open or merged PR matching the supplied plan,
which may now name a rewritten candidate — the same honest `--owner-state running`
or `unknown` call records that observation without a stopped attestation; it grants
no new delivery token, so nothing further can be sent under this reconciliation.
The same gap can recur after a token-authenticated `open` observation, when the
token needed to later report its merge or close is the one that got lost: the
identical owner, still honest about `running` or `unknown`, may advance that own
recorded `open` observation to `merged` or `closed` for the identical PR (same
repository, branch, marker, candidate_commit and PR) with no new delivery token;
a different PR, a different candidate, or any regression from `merged` still
requires a genuine stopped attestation.

## Follow the delivery to a recorded end

A recorded Draft is not the end of the job: while its delivery is `open`, every later
`claim` is refused. FO carries the PR on in this order, under the plan the Captain
approved (the plan presentation names these steps, so that approval covers them;
[Delivery authority](../../references/sd/workflow.md) is the task-PR rule this mirrors).
`OWNER_REPO` and `N` come from the recorded observation's `pr`.

Every wait below ends on a state, never on a change line. `add` records the PR as it is
now and reports only later changes, so a restarted session, a watch state lost with the
machine, or a second `add` of a listed PR never sees an earlier flip. Read the state
first, from the `<package>/scripts/pr_watch.py check` row (`OPEN`, `draft=`, `checks=`)
or `gh pr view`. Run `wait` only while the state is not yet true, and only as a wake-up:
it returns on the next change and never for a state already true. Do not `add` a PR the
`check` rows already list.

1. `python3 <package>/scripts/pr_watch.py add OWNER_REPO#N`, then read the state with
   `python3 <package>/scripts/pr_watch.py check`.
2. Wait for checks green on the Draft (row `checks=green`). A Draft with `checks=none`
   on two reads 60 seconds apart (CI skipped for drafts): mark it ready first and wait for
   green on the ready head instead.
3. `gh pr ready N --repo OWNER_REPO`.
4. Wait until the PR is ready (`draft=False`) and settled: at least 60 seconds since it
   became ready (the `gh pr ready` time, or for a flip this session did not make the last
   `ready_for_review` in `gh api --paginate repos/OWNER_REPO/issues/N/events`) with
   `checks=green` and nothing pending in that read, or the no-applicable-checks case
   below. A green read sooner may be the Draft run's. Read the PR as in step 6 and pass
   the head check below, then `delivery-record` the PR again with `draft` false and the
   same token. The 60 seconds is a bound, not a proof: a check that starts later is
   missed, and a workflow not run on ready shows the Draft's green, which is its answer.
5. Only then ask the Captain to merge, naming the PR, its head SHA (equal to the
   plan's `candidate_commit`), that it is ready, and the checks state. Merge stays the
   Captain's (ADR 0009): FO does not merge or enable auto-merge.
6. When the PR is `MERGED` or `CLOSED` (the watch reports `state OPEN -> MERGED` once, then
   drops it), read
   `gh pr view N --repo OWNER_REPO --json state,mergedAt,mergeCommit,isDraft,headRefOid`,
   pass the head check below, and `delivery-record` the observation with state `merged`
   or `closed` (`merge_commit` from `mergeCommit.oid` when merged).

Head check: before every `delivery-record` and before `delivery-recover`, compare the
read `headRefOid` with the plan's `candidate_commit`. The recorder takes
`candidate_commit` from the plan, not from the read, so it cannot see a different head.
On a mismatch FO records nothing, leaves the delivery `open`, and reports the PR with
both SHAs to the Captain.

No applicable checks: once the PR is ready (`draft=False`), if two `<package>/scripts/pr_watch.py
check` reads at least 60 seconds apart both show `checks=none` and
`gh pr view N --repo OWNER_REPO --json mergeStateStatus` is not `BLOCKED`, no check
applies to this change (a repository without checks, or path filters that exclude a
learning-only change, never shows one). FO does not wait for green: it records ready as
in step 4, and its merge ask states `checks=none: no check ran on the ready head`.
`BLOCKED` means GitHub still waits on a required check or review, so it is not this case:
FO leaves the delivery `open` and reports that state to the Captain instead of asking to
merge. Pending or failing checks are not this case either: wait for green, and failing
holds.

A Captain who declines the proposal closes the PR, and FO records `closed`. Do not
`release` an open delivery: it is refused.

When the watch report never arrived (a merge is reported once, and its state file
belongs to one machine), the token is lost, or the session restarted, settle from GitHub:
read the PR with the `gh pr view` of step 6 and pass the head check. If it is `OPEN`,
continue as the next paragraph says. If it is `MERGED` or `CLOSED`, act by who is acting:

- FO holds the token: `delivery-record` as in step 6. A missed watch report alone needs
  no recovery.
- A live owner without the token: `delivery-recover` with the same `--owner` as
  `delivery-claim`, `--owner-state running` or `unknown`, the plan and delivery digest
  from `notices --all`, and an observation built from that read. It advances the owner's
  own `open` observation and issues no new token.
- An owner confirmed stopped, or a different session taking the delivery over:
  `delivery-recover` with `--owner-state stopped`, the same plan, digest and observation.
  Never attest `stopped` for an owner that may still be running.

If the PR is `OPEN`, FO resumes from the first step the PR has not passed, judged by those
states (a PR already ready skips step 3; one the `check` rows do not list runs step 1), by
who is acting:

- FO holds the token: carry on with the steps; there is nothing to recover.
- A restarted session, or a different one taking over, whose previous owner is confirmed
  stopped: after the head check, `delivery-recover` with `--owner-state stopped`, the plan
  and delivery digest from `notices --all`, and an observation built from that read
  (`draft` as read), then use the new `delivery_token` for step 4 onward. The recorder
  refuses `running` and `unknown` for an open PR.
- A live owner without the token: carry on with steps 1, 2, 3 and 5 and skip the
  `draft` false record of step 4 (the recorder checks only that `draft` is a boolean);
  settle at `MERGED` or `CLOSED` as above.

A `claim` refused by an `open` sibling runs this read once and retries the `claim` once;
if the PR is still open, report `learn not run: blocked by job <id>` naming that PR.

## Present the result

Read `<package>/scripts/learning.py --repo CODE_ROOT notices --all` and, for any delivery
shown `open`, acknowledged or not, read its PR with `gh pr view` and settle it as the
section above says before presenting. Present only the items with `unread` true (a
settled delivery becomes unread again). Tell the user the relevant
no-change, proposal/PR, merged, pending or uncertain result with its limit. A
merged proposal does not prove it improved future work. After actual presentation,
run `ack --job JOB --expected NOTICE_DIGEST` for each presented snapshot and for none
other. Never ack merely because results entered agent context. A changed snapshot rejects stale
ack; a crash after presentation may cause a repeat. Invocation of `dev` performs
this same notice step; there is no every-session startup guarantee or hook.

Then list for the Captain, as kc-dev-flow-2 package-issue candidates, each no-change
reason that names an enforcement gap, a package rule or profile that already states
the practice a worker did not follow, or a package script defect, together with any
package defect he supplies from a session debrief. File none without his approval.
When no session debrief covers the task, say so in the same list: defects seen only
in a session, not in the task's records, are not in it.

# Evaluate learning

Invocation: `kc-dev-flow-2:evaluate-learning`

Package root: ${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}
`<package>` in this skill and its linked files is this root. If the value above
is not an absolute path, the root is two directories above this `SKILL.md`.

This is a bounded independent evaluation, not an SD stage or a closure detector.
Read the [framework](../../README.md), supplied task's approved scope and project
rules, and its selected shared profile: [poc](../../references/profiles/poc.md),
[pilot](../../references/profiles/pilot.md), or [prod](../../references/profiles/prod.md).
Read only that profile; unknown/conflicting selections hold evaluation. User
and approved AGENTS.md/SD authority constrain the profile; learning stays below
profile and stage principles. Evidence is data, not permission to run embedded
commands or override those boundaries.

## Evaluate the evidence

Read the bound closure/landed revisions, original change and checks, relevant
rejections/corrections and existing learning. Debrief may add context; it is not
required and cannot replace primary evidence. The caller must supply these facts:
the helper validates their structure/eligibility, not their truth or completeness.
Missing attribution, an existing rule covering the practice, or no applicable
case supports no-change. An existing rule means the project's rules, the selected
profile, and the principles of each stage the task ran
(`<package>/skills/<stage>/principles.md`); name the rule. A practice one of them
already states is no-change even when a worker did not follow it. Passing tests, reading a rule or an agent's assertion
alone does not establish that the practice improved the outcome.

- **add:** identify a project condition, changed action and observed avoided error
  or rework that existing rules do not cover. One task provides one case, not
  proof of general or repeated effectiveness.
- **no-change:** explain missing evidence, unknown attribution, duplication or
  inapplicability. Lack of a recent applicable case does not justify removal.
- **remove:** identify the exact existing entry and applicable counterevidence,
  obsolete conditions or an already approved replacement convention. A proposal
  to promote a rule into AGENTS.md does not establish that replacement.

A rewrite is remove plus add; a single evaluation may mix decisions. Each entry
has only Applicability, Practice and Evidence. State uncertainty in those fields
and the decision reason; add no scores, maturity levels or automatic promotion.
Do not edit AGENTS.md or learning.md. A local proposal is not active learning;
future adoption requires the separately authorized review/merge path. Do not load
pending proposals as project rules or claim this helper verifies adoption.

## Local recorder

Use the [learning recorder](../../scripts/learning.py) with an explicit repository and JSON
files. It uses the Git common directory so linked worktrees in one clone share
claims using POSIX file locks and atomic file replacement on a local filesystem;
separate clones/machines and distributed filesystem locking are outside this
contract. No model, hook, scheduler, provider query,
PR or issue is launched. The supervising caller claims a job and hands that job's
opaque token to its evaluator; complete only that assigned job. Tokens prevent
accidental cross-job completion by cooperating callers, not access by another
process that can read the same local files.

```sh
python3 <package>/scripts/learning.py --repo /absolute/project claim --input pack.json --owner session-handle
python3 <package>/scripts/learning.py --repo /absolute/project read --job JOB
python3 <package>/scripts/learning.py --repo /absolute/project complete --job JOB --token TOKEN --result evaluation.json
```

The strict pack shape is:

```json
{
  "schema_version": 1, "workflow": "docs/dev2", "task_id": "task-slug",
  "variant": "kc-dev-flow-2", "profile": "pilot",
  "closed": true, "merged": true, "verdict": "passed", "learning_task": false,
  "closure_revision": "<exact closure revision>", "landed_revision": "<exact landed revision>",
  "pr": "owner/repo#123", "evidence": ["<bound primary evidence and limits>"],
  "learning": [], "project_rules": ["<approved project authority>"]
}
```

`learning` contains existing entries with exactly `Applicability`, `Practice`,
`Evidence` (nonempty strings). Revision/PR strings are caller-supplied identifiers,
not queried or resolved by the recorder. Workflow and task ID are stable identities
within this clone; changing evidence for an existing claim is a conflict, not a
new automatic evaluation. Ineligible input creates no claim.

An evaluation has exactly `schema_version: 1` and nonempty `decisions`. Each
contains `action` (`add`, `remove`, `no-change`), `entry` (three-field entry for
add/remove, null for no-change), nonempty `reason`, and `evidence` (string list;
nonempty for add/remove; each reference must equal a supplied pack `evidence`
item). Remove must match a supplied existing entry; add must
not duplicate one. The helper checks schema/identity, not whether the reasoning
is sound. An all-no-change result has a null proposal, not an empty proposal.
A completed receipt remains a proposal record; it has no activation authority.

Pending means an owner has the claim, not that it is alive or stopped. Check its
actual session before recovery; a PID alone is insufficient. Missing/torn records
are uncertain and observation never retries them. After the supervisor verifies
the old owner stopped, explicit recovery can preserve the prior bytes, revoke
its token and claim a new attempt:

```sh
python3 <package>/scripts/learning.py --repo /absolute/project recover --job JOB \
  --expected DIGEST --owner-state stopped --reason 'Observed session ended; no completed evaluation' \
  --input pack.json --owner new-session-handle
```

Use the digest returned by read; a changed record refuses recovery. Running or
unknown owners require a hold. Completed results refuse both replacement and
recovery. Recovery is an explicit caller attestation, not automatic liveness
proof. Invalid completion input leaves a pending claim usable for correction;
a stale token cannot complete a recovered attempt. Report failures to the caller
without changing the closed development task or silently launching another job.

def declined_items(text):
    items = []
    for start in DECLINE_START.finditer(text):
        rest = text[start.end():]
        end = DECLINE_END.search(rest)
        depth, item = 0, ""
        for ch in (rest[:end.start()] if end else rest).strip().rstrip("."):
            depth = max(depth + (ch in "([") - (ch in ")]"), 0)
            if ch == ";" and depth == 0:
                items.append(item.strip())
                item = ""
            else:
                item += ch
        items.append(item.strip())
    return [item for item in items if item and item.lower() not in ("none", "nothing", "n/a")]


def brackets(item):
    found, depth, start = [], 0, 0
    for i, ch in enumerate(item):
        if ch == "(":
            start = i + 1 if depth == 0 else start
            depth += 1
        elif ch == ")" and depth:
            depth -= 1
            if depth == 0:
                found.append(item[start:i])
    return found


def unreasoned_items(text):
    return [item for item in declined_items(text) if not any(len(b.split()) >= 2 for b in brackets(item))]


def adr_names(repo, head, adr_dir):
    try:
        return gh("api", f"repos/{repo}/contents/{adr_dir}?ref={head}", "--jq", ".[].name").split()
    except RuntimeError as error:
        if "HTTP 404" in str(error):
            return []
        raise


def readme_front(path):
    scalars, lists, key = {}, {}, None
    lines = path.read_text(errors="replace").split("\n") if path.is_file() else []
    for line in lines[1:] if lines and lines[0] == "---" else []:
        if line == "---":
            break
        if m := re.match(r"^([\w-]+):[ \t]*(.*?)[ \t]*$", line):
            key, value = m.groups()
            scalars[key] = value.strip("'\"")
            if value.startswith("["):
                lists[key] = [v.strip().strip("'\"") for v in value.strip("[]").split(",") if v.strip()]
        elif key and (m := re.match(r"^[ \t]+-[ \t]+(.*?)[ \t]*$", line)):
            lists.setdefault(key, []).append(m.group(1).strip("'\""))
    return scalars, lists


def find_readme(task, workflow_dir):
    for folder in ([Path(workflow_dir)] if workflow_dir else [task.parent, task.parent.parent]):
        scalars, lists = readme_front(folder / "README.md")
        if "trunk" in scalars:
            return folder, scalars, lists
    return None, {}, {}


def repo_root(folder):
    return next((p for p in [folder.resolve(), *folder.resolve().parents] if (p / ".git").exists()), None)


def never_paths(paths, workflow_dir, scalars):
    extra = [re.compile(rf"^{re.escape(scalars[k].strip('/'))}(?:/|$)") for k in ("migrations-path", "adr-path") if scalars.get(k)]
    root = repo_root(workflow_dir) if workflow_dir else None
    if root:
        rel = workflow_dir.resolve().relative_to(root).as_posix()
        extra.append(re.compile(r"^README\.md$" if rel == "." else rf"^{re.escape(rel)}/README\.md$"))
    return [p for p in paths if any(r.search(p) for r in NEVER_PATH + extra)]


def classify(paths, never):
    if never:
        return "never"
    if paths and all(p.startswith("docs/") and p.endswith(".md") for p in paths):
        return "docs-only"
    names = {Path(p).name for p in paths}
    is_test = lambda p: Path(p).name.startswith("test_") or re.search(r"(?:\.test|\.spec|_test)\.\w+$", p)
    own_tests = lambda p: {f"test_{Path(p).name}", *(f"{Path(p).stem}{mid}{Path(p).suffix}" for mid in (".test", "_test", ".spec"))}
    code = [p for p in paths if Path(p).suffix in CODE and not is_test(p)]
    if code and all(Path(p).suffix in CODE for p in paths) and all(names & own_tests(p) for p in code):
        return "script-with-test"
    return "other"


def commit_date(path):
    done = subprocess.run(["git", "-C", str(path.parent), "log", "-1", "--format=%cs", "--", path.name], capture_output=True, text=True)
    if not done.returncode and done.stdout.strip():
        return done.stdout.strip()
    return datetime.datetime.fromtimestamp(path.stat().st_mtime, datetime.timezone.utc).strftime("%Y-%m-%d")


def points_for(task_text, gate_text, record, paths_never, facts, profile_prod, root):
    found = []
    reports = "\n".join(VALIDATION_SECTION.findall(task_text))
    prose = reports + "\n" + gate_text
    found += [("deferred", l) for l in prose.split("\n") if DEFERRED.search(l)]
    for block in FO_DECLINES.findall(task_text) + FO_DECLINES.findall(gate_text):
        found += [("fo-decline", l.strip()) for l in block.split("\n") if re.match(r"^\s*[-*] \S", l)]
    found += [("not-run", l) for l in prose.split("\n") if NOT_RUN.search(l)]
    found += [("acceptance-not-run", l) for l in reports.split("\n") if AC_NOT_RUN.search(l)]
    if record:
        since = commit_date(record)
        found += [("amendment", f"Amendment {n} dated {d}") for n, d in AMENDMENT.findall(task_text) if d >= since]
    found += [("path", p) for p in paths_never]
    if profile_prod:
        found.append(("profile", "prod"))
    surfaces = re.search(r"^Surfaces:(.*)$", task_text, re.M)
    found += [("surface", s) for s in (re.findall(r"[\w-]+", surfaces.group(1)) if surfaces else []) if s in ("db", "ui")]
    if root and (root / "release-please-config.json").exists() and not CONVENTIONAL.match(facts["title"]):
        found.append(("title", facts["title"]))
    found += [("second-reviewer", r) for r in dict.fromkeys(m.lower() for m in SECOND_REVIEWER.findall(gate_text))]
    lines = [f"point: {kind}: {tok(value)}" for kind, value in found]
    return lines[:MAX_POINTS] + ([f"point: more: {len(lines) - MAX_POINTS} not shown"] if len(lines) > MAX_POINTS else [])


def ci_problem(rollup):
    if not rollup:
        return "the check rollup is empty: no check has run on this head"
    bad = []
    for item in rollup:
        if item.get("__typename") == "StatusContext":
            ok = item.get("state") == "SUCCESS"
        else:
            ok = item.get("status") == "COMPLETED" and item.get("conclusion") == "SUCCESS"
        if not ok:
            bad.append(tok(item.get("name") or item.get("context") or "?", words=3, chars=40))
    return f"{len(bad)} of {len(rollup)} checks on this head are not finished and successful: {' '.join(bad[:5])}" if bad else None


def runs_problem(runs):
    newest = {}
    for run in runs:
        key = run.get("workflow_id")
        newest[key] = max(newest.get(key, 0), run.get("run_number", 0))
    bad = []
    for run in runs:
        superseded = run.get("run_number", 0) < newest[run.get("workflow_id")] and run.get("conclusion") in ("cancelled", "skipped")
        if not superseded and not (run.get("status") == "completed" and run.get("conclusion") == "success"):
            bad.append(tok(run.get("name") or "?", words=4, chars=40))
    return f"{len(bad)} of {len(runs)} workflow runs on this head are not finished and successful: {' '.join(bad[:5])}" if bad else None


def write_record(task, rec):
    folder = task.with_suffix("") / "merge"
    folder.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    taken = [int(m.group(1)) for p in folder.glob("ask-*.json") if (m := re.fullmatch(r"ask-(\d+)\.json", p.name))]
    path = folder / f"ask-{max(taken, default=0) + 1}.json"
    path.write_text(json.dumps(rec, indent=2, sort_keys=True) + "\n")
    return path


def check(args):
    task, text_file = Path(args.task), Path(args.text_file)

    except OSError as error:

        return 2
    if not pr:
        emit(f"--pr must look like owner/repo#N, got {tok(args.pr)}")
        return 2
    repo, number = pr.groups()
    problems, holds, nexts = [], [], []
    workflow_dir, scalars, lists = find_readme(task, args.workflow_dir)
    if not workflow_dir:
        holds.append("cannot find the workflow README with a trunk: next to the task or in --workflow-dir")

    candidates, record = dispatched_candidates(task)
    if not candidates:
        holds.append(f"no latest validation dispatch record under {task.with_suffix('')}/dispatch has a 'Candidate: <40-hex head>' line")
        nexts.append("next: hold the ask; dispatch validation of this head with a Candidate line, or tell the Captain.")
    if args.head:
        head = args.head.lower()
        if not re.fullmatch(r"[0-9a-f]{7,40}", head):
            holds.append(f"--head must be 7-40 hexadecimal characters, got {tok(args.head)}")
            head = None
    else:
        try:
            head = run_gh(repo, number).lower()
        except (OSError, RuntimeError, ValueError, KeyError, subprocess.SubprocessError) as error:
            holds.append(f"cannot read the head of {args.pr}: {error}")
            head = None
    if candidates and head:
        if not any(c.startswith(head) for c in candidates):
            problems.append(f"PR head {head} differs from dispatched candidate {' '.join(candidates)} (latest validation record {record.name})")
            nexts.append("next: hold the ask; revalidate this head or tell the Captain the difference.")

    facts = files = runs = None

    except (OSError, RuntimeError, ValueError, KeyError, subprocess.SubprocessError) as error:

    if facts is not None:
        full = str(facts.get("headRefOid", "")).lower()

            nexts.append("next: hold the ask; read the PR head again and revalidate it, or tell the Captain.")
        if (why := ci_problem(facts.get("statusCheckRollup"))):

        if runs is not None and (why := runs_problem(runs)):
            problems.append(why)
            nexts.append("next: hold the ask until every workflow run on this head has finished green.")
        if facts.get("isDraft"):

            nexts.append("next: hold the ask; mark the PR ready under the Captain's authority and let its CI finish.")
        if facts.get("mergeable") != "MERGEABLE":

            nexts.append("next: hold the ask until the PR merges cleanly into the trunk.")
        if scalars.get("trunk") and facts.get("baseRefName") != scalars["trunk"]:
            problems.append(f"the PR base {tok(facts.get('baseRefName'), words=1, chars=60)} is not the trunk {tok(scalars['trunk'], words=1, chars=60)}")

            nexts.append("next: hold the ask; the changed-file list is incomplete, tell the Captain.")

    reserved = sorted(task_facts(task)["adr"])
    if facts is not None and reserved:
        adr_dir = (scalars.get("adr-path") or "docs/adr").strip("/")
        try:
            names = adr_names(repo, str(facts["headRefOid"]).lower(), adr_dir)

                    problems.append(f"reserved ADR {number:04d} has no {adr_dir}/{number:04d}-*.md at PR head {str(facts['headRefOid'])[:12]}")
                    nexts.append(f"next: hold the ask; land the ADR file on this PR or delete the 'ADR: {number:04d}' line from the task, then run this check again.")

    security_errors, security_note = [], None
    at_head = [c for c in candidates if head and c.startswith(head)]
    if at_head:
        try:
            from validation_security import check_task as security_check
            security_errors, security_note = security_check(task, at_head)
        except (OSError, UnicodeDecodeError) as error:
            security_errors = [f"cannot read the validation security review: {error}"]
    for error in security_errors:
        problems.append(error)
        nexts.append("next: hold the ask; run the validation security review at this head, or tell the Captain.")

    for reviewer in unstated_second_reviewers(gate_text):
        nexts.append("next: hold the ask until each second reviewer has an outcome.")
        problems.append(f"second reviewer {reviewer} has no stated outcome: "
                        f"add '{reviewer} not run: <reason>' or a review:<id> or comment:<id> in a sentence naming {reviewer}")

    for item in unreasoned_items(gate_text):
        problems.append(f"declined item has no reason: {tok(item)}")
        nexts.append("next: hold the ask; write each declined item as '<class>, <finding> (<reason, two or more words>)', then run this check again.")

    emit(*problems, *holds)
    if problems:
        emit(*dict.fromkeys(nexts))
        return 1
    if holds:
        emit(*(dict.fromkeys(nexts) or ["next: hold the ask and show the Captain these lines."]))
        return 2
    emit(f"PR head {head} equals dispatched candidate {head}; no second reviewer outcome is missing")
    if security_note:
        emit(security_note)
    paths = list(dict.fromkeys(p for f in files for p in (f.get("filename"), f.get("previous_filename")) if p))
    never = never_paths(paths, workflow_dir, scalars)
    root = repo_root(workflow_dir)
    release_pr = str(facts.get("headRefName", "")).startswith("release-please--")
    front = re.match(r"---\n(.*?)\n---", task_text, re.S)
    profile_prod = bool(front and (m := FM_PROFILE.search(front.group(1))) and m.group(1) == "prod")
    cls = classify(paths, never or release_pr or profile_prod or bool(re.search(r"^Surfaces:.*\bdb\b", task_text, re.M)))
    points = points_for(task_text, gate_text, record, never, facts, profile_prod, root)
    verdict = "merge" if not points and cls != "never" else "ask"
    emit(*points, f"class: {cls}")

    saved = write_record(task, {"pr": args.pr, "head": full, "class": cls, "verdict": verdict, "model": "not run",
                                "points": points, "next": ASK, "time": utcnow().strftime("%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ")})
    emit(f"record: {task.stem}/merge/{saved.name}", ASK)
    return 0


def main(argv=None):

"""Check what FO is about to ask the Captain to merge.

Usage: delivery_gate.py check <task file> --pr <owner/repo>#<N> --text-file <file> [--head <sha>] [--workflow-dir <dir>]

The dispatched heads are the whole `Candidate: <40-hex head>` lines above the first `## ` heading of the
highest-numbered `<task folder>/dispatch/validation-<N>.md` record; the check reads no validation verdict.
A task whose frontmatter says `profile: prod` must also pass `validation_security.py` (saved security review at
the dispatched head the PR head equals, every finding disposed); a profile that cannot be read as poc, pilot or prod holds.
The PR head is compared, as a prefix, with each line; it passes when it matches one (--head, else `gh pr view --json headRefOid`).
--text-file holds the gate question and summary: each `Second reviewer: <X> because` needs `<X> not run: <reason>`
or, in one sentence naming <X>, a `review:<id>` or `comment:<id>` token. Each `;`-separated item after `Declined...:` or
`FO declines...:` (up to the next sentence that opens with a label and a colon, or a blank line) needs a bracket of two or
more words holding its reason; this proves a bracket exists, not that it is a reason.
The PR is also read with `gh pr view` and `gh api --paginate .../pulls/<N>/files`. Exit 1 holds the ask when the head differs,
a second reviewer has no stated outcome, a declined item has no bracketed reason, an `ADR: NNNN` the task reserves under
`## Number guards` has no `<adr-path>/NNNN-*.md` in the directory at the PR head (README `adr-path:`, default `docs/adr`;
the directory is read, not the PR's file list), a prod task's security review fails, a check run on the head is not finished and
successful (an empty rollup, SKIPPED and NEUTRAL included), the PR is a draft or not mergeable, its base is not the README's
`trunk:`, or the file list is shorter than `changedFiles`. Exit 2 when the record has no Candidate line, a head, the PR or the
README cannot be read, or an input is unusable. Every problem is printed.
Exit 0 prints `point:` lines (pointers into the records and the changed paths, at most 12, each value an escaped bounded token),
one `class:` line (never, docs-only, script-with-test or other, by allowlist), the saved record `<task>/merge/ask-<N>.json`
and one last `next:` line, the `ASK` line: merge when the approved question named the merge, else ask.

"""Watch the pull requests FO opened and report what changed since the last look.

  pr_watch.py [--state FILE] add [--codex] [--copilot] owner/repo#N ...
                                                    add PRs; --codex / --copilot also read that review
  pr_watch.py [--state FILE] check                  print each PR and the changes since the last look
  pr_watch.py [--state FILE] wait [SECONDS]         poll until an outcome changes, print it and exit 0
  pr_watch.py [--state FILE] tasks WORKFLOW_DIR     read the workflow's tasks and print each next step

Without --state the list is kept per session in ~/.local/state/kc-dev-flow-2/pr-watch/<id>.json, where id is
$CLAUDE_CODE_SESSION_ID (shared by FO, its workers and its background commands), else a hash of the working
directory; the older shared pr-watch.json is not read.

An outcome is a merge or close, a draft flip, a new or cleared conflict, CI turning green
or failing, a Codex verdict, or Copilot answering or refusing the head; a check or review that only
starts is recorded silently.

A PR with no check runs (`checks=none`) has no outcome to wait for. Once it has shown `checks=none` for
60 seconds on the same head and draft state with mergeStateStatus not BLOCKED, the `unchecked` column
reads `settled` and counts as green (the learn extension's no-applicable-checks rule). The 60 seconds is a
bound, not a proof: a check that starts later is missed, and its later green is still reported.

A Codex or Copilot outcome already there when add first looks is printed as "already" and
reported by the next wait, once.

A merged or closed PR is reported once, then dropped. The codex and copilot columns are read
only for a PR added with --codex or --copilot, from that extension's reader when it is
present. Exit 2 is a configuration error.

tasks adds each open task PR to the watch list, with the codex and copilot columns when the workflow README
lists those extensions, and prints one `fact:` line per open task PR (state, draft, checks, reviewer outcomes
with their review id) and one `next:` line per action FO owes: recording a PR a worker opened, marking a green
draft ready, the observer check ahead of the merge sentinel, keeping one wait running, a task's newest
dispatch record that names a package script without a directory (dispatch_records.py --newest), and a
chief-engineer or engineering-reviewer call a live task owes (role_triggers.py). It prints no merge-ask
or hold line: FO runs delivery_gate.py under the README. wait prints a `next:` line after each decisive
change. Exit 2 when a task cannot be read.
"""
import argparse
import contextlib
import fcntl
import hashlib
import json
import re
import os
from pathlib import Path
import shlex
import subprocess
import sys
import time

SESSION_ID = re.compile(r"[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9._-]{0,127}")
SCRIPTS = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
CODEX = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1] / "extensions/codex/codex_review.py"
COPILOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1] / "extensions/copilot/copilot_review.py"
FIELDS = "state,isDraft,mergeable,mergeStateStatus,headRefOid,statusCheckRollup,title"
SETTLE_SECONDS = 60
TRACKED = ("state", "draft", "mergeable", "checks", "unchecked", "head", "codex", "codex-evidence",
           "copilot", "copilot-evidence")
OUTCOMES = {"state": None, "draft": None, "mergeable": {"CONFLICTING"},
            "checks": {"failing", "green"}, "unchecked": {"settled"}, "codex": {"clean", "findings", "error"},
            "copilot": {"answered", "not-run", "error"}}


def default_state():
    session = os.environ.get("CLAUDE_CODE_SESSION_ID", "")
    key = session if SESSION_ID.fullmatch(session) else \
        "cwd-" + hashlib.sha256(os.path.realpath(os.getcwd()).encode()).hexdigest()[:12]
    return Path.home() / ".local/state/kc-dev-flow-2/pr-watch" / f"{key}.json"


def outcome(key, old, new):
    if key.endswith("-evidence"):
        return new not in ("-", None)
    return key in OUTCOMES and (OUTCOMES[key] is None or new in OUTCOMES[key] or (key == "mergeable" and old == "CONFLICTING"))


def gh(*args):
    done = subprocess.run(["gh", *args], capture_output=True, text=True)
    if done.returncode:
        raise RuntimeError(done.stderr.strip() or "gh failed")
    return json.loads(done.stdout)


def checks(rollup):
    states = [(c.get("conclusion") or c.get("state") or c.get("status") or "").upper() for c in rollup or []]
    if any(s in ("FAILURE", "ERROR", "CANCELLED", "TIMED_OUT", "ACTION_REQUIRED", "STARTUP_FAILURE") for s in states):
        return "failing"
    if any(s in ("", "PENDING", "QUEUED", "IN_PROGRESS", "EXPECTED", "WAITING") for s in states):
        return "pending"
    return "green" if states else "none"


def reader(script, repo, number, words=None):
    if not script.exists():
        return "-", "-"
    done = subprocess.run([sys.executable, str(script), repo, number], capture_output=True, text=True)
    evidence = (re.findall(r"evidence=(\S+)", done.stdout) or [None])[-1]
    verdict = (words or {0: "clean", 1: "findings", 3: "running", 4: "not-reviewed"}).get(done.returncode, "error")
    return verdict, evidence or "-"


def codex(repo, number):
    return reader(CODEX, repo, number)


def copilot(repo, number):
    return reader(COPILOT, repo, number, {0: "answered", 3: "requested", 4: "not-reviewed", 5: "not-run"})


def look(ref, view=gh, review=codex, with_codex=False, with_copilot=False, review_copilot=copilot):
    repo, number = ref.split("#")
    d = view("pr", "view", number, "--repo", repo, "--json", FIELDS)
    snap = {"state": d["state"], "draft": d["isDraft"], "mergeable": d["mergeable"],
            "merge-state": d.get("mergeStateStatus", ""), "checks": checks(d["statusCheckRollup"]), "head": d["headRefOid"][:9], "title": d["title"][:60]}
    read = with_codex and d["state"] == "OPEN"
    snap["codex"], snap["codex-evidence"] = review(repo, number) if read else ("-", "-")
    snap["watch-codex"] = with_codex
    read = with_copilot and d["state"] == "OPEN"
    snap["copilot"], snap["copilot-evidence"] = review_copilot(repo, number) if read else ("-", "-")
    snap["watch-copilot"] = with_copilot
    return snap


def settle(snap, old, clock=time.time):
    key = [snap["draft"], snap["head"]]
    quiet = snap["state"] == "OPEN" and snap["checks"] == "none"
    since = old.get("none-since") if old.get("none-key") == key else None
    since = (since if since is not None else clock()) if quiet else None
    snap["none-key"], snap["none-since"] = (key, since) if quiet else (None, None)
    snap["unchecked"] = "settled" if quiet and clock() - since >= SETTLE_SECONDS and snap.get("merge-state") != "BLOCKED" else "-"
    return snap


def round_line(name, snap):
    evidence = snap.get(f"{name}-evidence", "-")
    return f"next: read the {name} round{'' if evidence in ('-', None) else ' ' + evidence} as FO steps: review findings say."


def facts(ref, snap):
    parts = [ref, snap["state"], f"draft={snap['draft']}", f"checks={snap['checks']}"]
    parts += ["unchecked=settled"] if snap.get("unchecked") == "settled" else []
    for name in ("codex", "copilot"):
        if snap.get(f"watch-{name}"):
            evidence = snap.get(f"{name}-evidence", "-")
            parts.append(f"{name}={snap.get(name, '-')}" + ("" if evidence in ("-", None) else f" {evidence}"))
    return "fact: " + " ".join(parts)


def next_for(ref, snap):
    if snap.get("mergeable") == "CONFLICTING":
        return [f"next: tell the Captain {ref} has a conflict."]
    if snap.get("checks") == "failing":
        return [f"next: tell the Captain {ref} has failing CI."]
    green = snap.get("checks") == "green" or (snap.get("checks") == "none" and snap.get("unchecked") == "settled")
    return [f"next: mark {ref} ready if Delivery authority allows."] if green and snap.get("draft") else []


def wait_next(ref, now, decisive):
    if now.get("state") != "OPEN":
        return ["next: run the idle hooks now."]
    lines = [round_line(name, now) for name in ("codex", "copilot") if {name, f"{name}-evidence"} & set(decisive)]
    return lines + (next_for(ref, now) if {"mergeable", "draft", "checks", "unchecked"} & set(decisive) else [])


def load(state):
    return json.loads(state.read_text()) if state.exists() else {}


@contextlib.contextmanager
def locked(state):
    state.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    with open(state.with_name(state.name + ".lock"), "w") as lock:
        fcntl.flock(lock, fcntl.LOCK_EX)
        yield


def update(state, put=(), drop=(), keep_flags=False, expected=None):
    with locked(state):
        current = load(state)

# 0015. The implementation worker opens the Draft PR before validation

Date: 2026-10-14

## Status

Accepted

## Context

In this workflow the implementation worker opens the Draft PR, so external review (Codex, Copilot, RoboRev) runs on the PR head before the delivery gate. Spacedock's `pr-merge` merge hook instead creates the PR at delivery, and its text has no branch for a PR that already exists. `merge guard` arms that hook only while `pr` is empty: in Spacedock 0.27.0 `internal/status/merge.go` the classifier's `pr != ""` case returns `blocked` before the arm case. Probe 2026-10-14, spacedock 0.27.2, scratch copy of the `merge-pr-workflow` fixture holding only `pr-merge.md`: `merge guard 020 --verdict passed` with `pr` empty printed `armed: mod-block set to merge:pr-merge`; the same entity with `pr: "#42"` printed `blocked: PR #42 is pending`. The worker-opened PR left `pr` empty (task `followup-dispatch-records-checked`, PR #642 open at validation with `pr` unset), so nothing scanned it, and in a relay run the FO learned of a merge only when the Captain said so.

## Decision

**Words:** 「1」 — Captain, 2026-10-14, chat, answering FO's two options: 「1. 把早開 PR 變成正式規則（我建議這個）：刪掉 mod 的 merge hook，在 idle 步驟加一條「PR 開了就記下編號」。這保留合併前的審查，也補上合併後自動偵測的漏洞。代價是和套件原本的說明不一致，那句說明要跟著改，這個決定也應該寫成一份 ADR。 2. 改回套件原本的路：實作只做到 commit，PR 交給 merge hook 開。」

**Words:** 「准」 — Captain, 2026-10-14, at the redone ideation gate, accepting FO's recommendation on who may open the Draft PR. The gate question stated: "this approval is that grant for this task: the implementation worker may push the task branch and open a Draft PR in iamcxa/kc-claude-plugins".

The implementation worker opens the task branch's Draft PR before validation where its dispatch scope notes quote the Captain's push grant, and names it in its report; without a quoted grant it opens nothing and reports `no PR opened: no push grant`. The grant covers a Draft only: ready and merge still need the Captain's word. FO records the PR in the task's `pr` field as `<owner/repo>#<N>` from the `next:` lines of `python3 <package>/scripts/pr_watch.py tasks` at startup and idle, and the kc-dev-flow-2 mod carries no merge hook. With `pr` set, `merge guard` arms no hook and the `pr-merge` startup and idle hooks wait for the merge, then record the sentinel. The `references/sd/workflow.md` sentence "Use SD's pending terminal approval and existing merge hook; do not invent another PR stage" is replaced by this rule.

**Options considered:**
- the worker opens the Draft PR under a quoted push grant and `pr` is recorded from `tasks` output (chosen)
- FO presents the candidate and PR body after implementation and opens the PR on the Captain's go — not chosen: one more message and approval from him per task
- implementation stops at the commit and `pr-merge`'s merge hook opens the PR — not chosen by the Captain; it gives up the review before merge that the first option keeps, and the hook has no branch for a PR opened earlier

**Recommended:** the first option, as the Captain accepted.

## Consequences

The package's usage differs from `pr-merge`'s own text, which still says its merge hook creates the PR; that hook never runs here while `pr` is set, and it would try to create a second PR if `pr` were empty at the guard. The recording is enforced by output, not prose: `tasks` lists the branch's PRs in any state except CLOSED, so a PR merged between two FO passes is still recorded by the next one and `pr-merge` then finds it MERGED. A gate question that forgets the grant leaves the worker opening nothing, and the PR then opens at delivery. `pr_watch.py` state is a machine-local file, so each session re-adds its PRs. Reopen if Spacedock's `pr-merge` gains an existing-PR branch.
# 0011. FO decides for the Captain only by a four-level delegation ladder

Date: 2026-10-12

## Status

Accepted

## Context

The Captain wants dev2 to learn his decision trajectory and, at high confidence, decide
on his behalf: 「讓 FO 可以依據 ADR 以及自我學習與改進的結果，可以代替我決策」 (chat,
2026-10-12). ADR 0009 covers the same direction for package self-improvement only, and
left open how work is triggered when a task closes.

Two facts measured on 2026-10-12 over one adopter's state branch (its active and archived task files)
bear on it. `python3 kc-dev-flow-2/scripts/decision_ledger.py` read 168 gate resolutions and
15 withdrawals, matching `grep -c` of `decision:`, `resolution:` and `withdrawal:` lines;
9 resolutions were recorded by `agent:first-officer` under a quoted grant. No gate record
carries an `Override:` line, so no area yet shows when the Captain chose against FO.

## Decision

**Words:** 「可以，就照此方向。」 — Captain, chat, 2026-10-12

**Asked:** 「**要你決定：** 照這個方向做下一批嗎？內容是 learn 擴充（歸檔時觸發）加上決策帳本，再加 L2「依先例代決」。L3 等資料夠了再說。我建議做，並把整條授權階梯另外寫成一份 ADR，和 ADR 0009 互相引用。」

**Options considered:**
- a four-level ladder, built up from L2, with L3 waiting for ledger data (chosen)
- not in this batch, the other answer to the yes-or-no question asked

**Recommended:** the four-level ladder

FO decides for the Captain only at one of four levels:

- **L0:** FO recommends; the Captain decides. The default.
- **L1:** a gate question that says approval accepts FO's recommendation (workflow
  README, `## FO steps: review findings`).
- **L2, decide by precedent:** a decision an accepted ADR already settles is applied by
  FO and stated in the gate summary as `Precedent: ADR <number> — 「<Words line>」`; the
  Captain may reopen it.
- **L3, decide by record:** not built. A class of decisions moves to L3 only by a Captain
  grant recorded as its own ADR, on ledger evidence that his rulings in that area agreed
  with FO and were not later amended. Any reversal returns the area to L0.

Authority, gate approval, merge, outward-facing actions, irreversible changes and money
are never delegated at any level. A delegated decision is recorded as FO's decision with
its basis, never as the Captain's words.

The decision ledger is derived, not stored: `decision_ledger.py` reads the gate records
SD already writes (who, when, decision, reason, grant, briefing question) plus
`Override:` lines and `## Captain amendments`. The learn extension runs `learn` and the
observer when FO archives a task.

This answers ADR 0009's open trigger at task close for adopters that list the learn
extension. L3 needs `Override:` lines to accumulate before any area shows a record; the
ledger's `amended_after` counts amendments dated on or after a ruling, which approximates
a later reversal and can over-count. Reopen if an L2 precedent is reopened by the Captain
twice in one area, or if the ledger cannot separate areas well enough to support an L3
grant.

# dev2 laws

Invariants of the committed `spacedock-state` history, checked by `<package>/scripts/laws_check.py`
and listed here so a reader can see what each law is for. Each run judges only the events the commits of
one push add, the `before..after` range GitHub reports for a push to the state branch, each read at its own
commit. A violation is reported in the run of the push that added it; the next push is judged on its own
commits, so its run is green again whether or not the violation was repaired. The run reports; it does not
block `merge guard`, a dispatch or a push. `<package>/scripts/test_laws_check.py` fails when this list and
the runner's registry differ.

## L1 observer-before-sentinel

- **Rule.** When the workflow README lists `learn`, an observer report, or its `observer not run: <reason>`
  line, is committed no later than the commit that writes `pr: pr-merge:<N>` in a task's frontmatter.
- **Event.** A commit in the range where a top-level or `_archive/` `<slug>.md` has a parsed `pr:` sentinel
  and its first parent's file, followed through a rename, did not. The sentinel is read from parsed
  frontmatter, not by substring. An archive move that leaves `pr:` unchanged is no event; a `merge guard --rework`
  that clears `pr:` and a later sentinel are two events.
- **Judged by.** `<package>/scripts/observer_check.py <state> <slug> --rev <that commit>`.
- **Bit.** An adopter's first officer archived a task with no observer report (2026-10-14).
  `observer-before-merge-guard` introduced the rule; its report is committed one commit before its sentinel.
- **Bounds.** The README is the one supplied at run time, so a re-run or a local run given a different README
  can judge the same range differently.

## L2 dispatch-record-complete

- **Rule.** Each dispatch record has every part `<package>/scripts/dispatch_records.py` requires and names no package script
  without its directory; a first implementation record carries each `ADR:` or `Migration:` line its task reserves; and each
  Captain amendment of its task is named in a dispatch checklist.
- **Event.** A commit in the range that adds a `dispatch/<name>.md` record, status added, or renamed from a path
  that is not a dispatch record. A record added, then corrected or deleted in a later commit of the same push, is
  judged as added; a record deleted and added again is judged at each add. Archiving a task or renaming its folder
  is no event.
- **Judged by.** `<package>/scripts/dispatch_records.py <task folder>` and
  `<package>/scripts/dispatch_records.py --names <records>`, both over the record, its folder and the task file beside the

"""Derive the gate decision ledger from a kc-dev-flow-2 state checkout.

Reads every task file (active and `_archive/`), never writes. One JSON line per gate
resolution or withdrawal; `--summary` prints counts per area instead.
"""
import argparse
import json
import re
import sys
from pathlib import Path

OVERRIDE = re.compile(
    r"Override:\s*recommended\s+(?P<rec>.+?);\s*Captain chose\s+(?P<chose>.+?);\s*area:\s*(?P<area>[^;.\n']+)")
SURFACES = re.compile(r"^Surfaces:\s*(.+)$", re.M)
AMENDMENT = re.compile(r"^### Amendment (\d+) — (\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2})", re.M)
KEY = re.compile(r"^(?P<indent> *)(?:- )?(?P<key>[a-z-]+):(?: (?P<value>.*))?$")


def unquote(raw):
    raw = raw.strip()
    if raw.startswith("'") and raw.endswith("'") and len(raw) >= 2:
        return raw[1:-1].replace("''", "'")
    if raw.startswith('"') and raw.endswith('"') and len(raw) >= 2:
        return json.loads(raw)
    return raw


def split_task(text):
    if not text.startswith("---\n"):
        return None, text
    end = text.find("\n---\n", 4)
    if end < 0:
        return None, text
    return text[4:end].split("\n"), text[end + 5:]


def scalar(lines, i, indent):
    """Value of the key on line i; YAML folds continuation lines into one space."""
    parts = [KEY.match(lines[i]).group("value") or ""]
    j = i + 1
    while j < len(lines) and lines[j].strip() and len(lines[j]) - len(lines[j].lstrip(" ")) > indent:
        parts.append(lines[j].strip())
        j += 1
    return unquote(" ".join(p for p in parts if p))


def gate_entries(fm):
    """Walk the SD-written `gates:` block; yield one dict per resolution or withdrawal."""
    stage = attempt = room = None
    entry = None
    entry_indent = conn_indent = -1
    in_gates = False
    for i, line in enumerate(fm):
        m = KEY.match(line)
        if not m:
            continue
        indent = len(m.group("indent")) + (2 if line.lstrip().startswith("- ") else 0)
        key, value = m.group("key"), m.group("value")
        if indent == 0:
            in_gates = key == "gates"
            continue
        if not in_gates:
            continue
        if entry is not None and indent <= entry_indent:
            yield entry
            entry = None
        if key == "stage":
            stage = value
        elif key == "id" and (value or "").startswith("gate-attempt:"):
            attempt, room = value, None
        elif key == "room-ref":
            room = value
        elif key in ("resolution", "withdrawal") and value is None:
            entry = {"stage": stage, "attempt": attempt, "kind": key, "room": room}
            entry_indent = indent
        elif entry is not None:
            if key == "conn":
                conn_indent = indent
            elif conn_indent >= 0 and indent > conn_indent and key in ("quote", "source"):
                entry["conn_" + key] = scalar(fm, i, indent)
            elif key in ("by", "at", "decision", "reason"):
                conn_indent = -1
                entry[key] = scalar(fm, i, indent)
    if entry is not None:
        yield entry


def question(state, task_path, room):
    if not room:
        return None
    index = (task_path.parent / room / "index.json")
    try:
        return json.loads(index.read_text())["question"]
    except (OSError, ValueError, KeyError):
        return None


def task_rows(state, path):
    fm, body = split_task(path.read_text())
    if fm is None:
        return []
    surfaces = SURFACES.search(body)
    amendments = [(int(n), d) for n, d in AMENDMENT.findall(body)]
    rows = []
    for e in gate_entries(fm):
        reason = e.get("reason") or ""
        over = OVERRIDE.search(reason)
        date = (e.get("at") or "")[:10]
        rows.append({
            "task": path.stem,
            "archived": path.parent.name == "_archive",
            "stage": e["stage"],
            "attempt": e["attempt"],
            "kind": e["kind"],
            "by": e.get("by"),
            "at": e.get("at"),
            "decision": e.get("decision") if e["kind"] == "resolution" else "withdraw",
            "reason": reason,
            "conn_quote": e.get("conn_quote"),
            "conn_source": e.get("conn_source"),
            "question": question(state, path, e.get("room")),
            "override": over.groupdict() if over else None,
            "area": over.group("area").strip() if over else (surfaces.group(1).strip() if surfaces else None),
            "amended_after": sum(1 for _, d in amendments if date and d >= date),
        })
    return rows


def ledger(state):
    paths = sorted(state.glob("*.md")) + sorted((state / "_archive").glob("*.md"))
    rows = []
    for p in paths:
        if p.name != "README.md":
            rows.extend(task_rows(state, p))
    return rows


def summary(rows):
    out = {}
    for r in rows:
        if r["kind"] != "resolution":
            continue
        s = out.setdefault(r["area"] or "unknown", {
            "rulings": 0, "captain": 0, "fo_delegated": 0, "overrides": 0, "amended_after": 0})
        s["rulings"] += 1
        s["captain"] += r["by"] == "person:captain"
        s["fo_delegated"] += r["by"] == "agent:first-officer"
        s["overrides"] += r["override"] is not None
        s["amended_after"] += r["amended_after"] > 0
    return out


def main(argv=None):
    ap = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    ap.add_argument("state", type=Path, help="state checkout holding the task files")
    ap.add_argument("--summary", action="store_true", help="counts per area instead of rows")
    args = ap.parse_args(argv)
    if not args.state.is_dir():
        print(f"not a directory: {args.state}", file=sys.stderr)
        return 2
    rows = ledger(args.state)
    if args.summary:
        print(json.dumps(summary(rows), ensure_ascii=False, indent=2))
    else:
        for r in rows:
            print(json.dumps(r, ensure_ascii=False))
    return 0


if __name__ == "__main__":
    sys.exit(main())

def read_flags(known, ref, codex, copilot):
    return (codex or known.get(ref, {}).get("watch-codex", ref in known),
            copilot or known.get(ref, {}).get("watch-copilot", False))


def record(state, known, snaps):
    already = []
    for ref, snap in snaps.items():
        for key in ("codex", "copilot"):
            stored = known.get(ref, {})
            if snap[key] in OUTCOMES[key] and (snap[key], snap[f"{key}-evidence"]) != (
                    stored.get(key), stored.get(f"{key}-evidence")):
                already.append(f"{ref}: {key} {snap[key]} already (wait reports it)")
                snap[key], snap[f"{key}-evidence"] = "-", "-"
    return already, update(state, put=snaps, keep_flags=True)


def sweep(state, look=look, nexts=None, clock=time.time):
    seen = load(state)
    start = {ref: dict(entry) for ref, entry in seen.items()}
    changes, rows = [], []
    for ref, old in seen.items():
        old = {"unchecked": "-", **old}
        try:
            now = settle(dict(look(ref, with_codex=old.get("watch-codex", True), with_copilot=old.get("watch-copilot", False))), old, clock)
        except (RuntimeError, KeyError, ValueError) as error:
            rows.append(f"{ref}: not read ({str(error)[:80]})")
            continue
        moved = [k for k in TRACKED if old.get(k) != now.get(k)]
        if moved:
            line = f"{ref} {now['title']}: " + "; ".join(f"{k} {old.get(k)} -> {now.get(k)}" for k in moved)
            decisive = [k for k in moved if outcome(k, old.get(k), now.get(k))]
            changes.append((line, bool(decisive)))
            if decisive and nexts is not None:
                nexts.extend(n for n in wait_next(ref, now, decisive) if n not in nexts)
        rows.append(f"{ref:34} {now['state']:7} draft={now['draft']!s:5} {now['mergeable']:11} "
                    f"checks={now['checks']:8} codex={now['codex']:12} "
                    f"copilot={now.get('copilot', '-'):12} {now['title']}")
        seen[ref] = {**old, **now}
    reported = {line.split(" ")[0] for line, _ in changes}
    done = [ref for ref, s in seen.items() if s["state"] != "OPEN" and ref not in reported]
    current = update(state, put={r: s for r, s in seen.items() if r not in done}, drop=done, keep_flags=True, expected=start)
    return changes, rows, bool(current)


def front(path):
    lines = path.read_text(errors="replace").split("\n")
    found = {}
    for line in lines[1:] if lines and lines[0] == "---" else []:
        if line == "---":
            break
        match = re.match(r"^([\w-]+):[ \t]*(.*?)[ \t]*$", line)
        if match:
            found[match.group(1)] = match.group(2).strip("'\"")
    return found


def git(*args):
    done = subprocess.run(["git", *args], capture_output=True, text=True)
    if done.returncode:
        raise RuntimeError(done.stderr.strip() or f"git {args[2] if len(args) > 2 else ''} failed")
    return done.stdout.strip()


def toplevel(workflow):
    return Path(git("-C", str(workflow), "rev-parse", "--show-toplevel"))


def repo_of(worktree, ask):
    url = git("-C", str(worktree), "remote", "get-url", "origin")
    return ask("repo", "view", url, "--json", "nameWithOwner")["nameWithOwner"]


def opened_pr(worktree, ask):
    repo = repo_of(worktree, ask)
    branch = git("-C", str(worktree), "branch", "--show-current")
    listed = ask("pr", "list", "--repo", repo, "--head", branch, "--state", "all", "--json", "number,state")
    found = [p for p in listed if p["state"] in ("OPEN", "MERGED")]
    return f"{repo}#{found[0]['number']}" if found else None


def entities(state):
    found = {}
    for path in sorted(state.iterdir()):
        name = path.name
        if name.startswith(".") or name in ("_archive", "_mods"):
            continue
        if path.is_dir() and (path / "index.md").is_file():
            found[name] = path / "index.md"
        elif path.is_file() and name.endswith(".md") and name != "README.md":
            found.setdefault(path.stem, path)
    return sorted(found.items())


def tasks(opts, look=look, ask=gh, clock=time.time):
    workflow = Path(opts.args[0]).resolve()
    readme = front(workflow / "README.md")
    state = workflow / readme["state"] if readme.get("state") else workflow
    listed = set(re.findall(r"[\w-]+", readme.get("extensions", "")))
    wait = f"python3 {SCRIPTS / 'pr_watch.py'}" + (f" --state {shlex.quote(str(opts.state))}" if opts.given else "")
    out, snaps, errors = [], {}, []
    for slug, task in entities(state):
        meta = front(task)
        if "status" not in meta:
            continue
        if (state / slug / "dispatch").is_dir():
            done = subprocess.run([sys.executable, str(SCRIPTS / "dispatch_records.py"), "--newest", str(state), slug],
                                  capture_output=True, text=True)
            hits = re.findall(r"^(.+?):\d+: bare package script name (\S+)$", done.stdout, re.M)
            if done.returncode == 1 and hits:
                names = ", ".join(dict.fromkeys(name for _, name in hits))
                out.append(f"next: {slug}'s newest dispatch record {hits[0][0]} names {names} without a directory; "
                           "if its worker is live, send a follow-up writing each with its absolute package path "
                           "and save it as the next record, else do nothing.")
            elif done.returncode:
                errors.append(f"next: report {slug} to the Captain: {(done.stdout or done.stderr).strip()[:120]}.")
        done = subprocess.run([sys.executable, str(SCRIPTS / "role_triggers.py"), str(state), slug], capture_output=True, text=True)
        if done.returncode == 1:
            out += done.stdout.splitlines()
        elif done.returncode:
            errors.append(f"next: report {slug} to the Captain: {(done.stdout or done.stderr).strip()[:120]}.")
        pr = meta.get("pr", "")
        try:
            where = toplevel(workflow) / meta["worktree"] if not pr and meta.get("worktree") else None
            if where and not where.is_dir():
                out.append(f"next: record {slug}'s PR with status --set {slug} pr=<owner/repo>#<N>; its worktree is not on this machine.")
            elif where:
                ref = opened_pr(where, ask)
                if ref:
                    out += [f"next: run `spacedock status --workflow-dir {shlex.quote(str(workflow))} --set {slug} pr={ref}`.",
                            f"next: run `spacedock state commit {slug} --workflow-dir {shlex.quote(str(workflow))}`."]
                    pr = ref
            qualified = re.fullmatch(r"([\w.-]+/[\w.-]+)#(\d+)", pr)
            bare = re.fullmatch(r"#?(\d+)", pr)
            if not (qualified or bare):
                continue
            ref = pr if qualified else f"{repo_of(toplevel(workflow), ask)}#{bare.group(1)}"
            known = load(opts.state)
            codex, copilot = read_flags(known, ref, "codex" in listed, "copilot" in listed)
            now = settle(dict(look(ref, with_codex=codex, with_copilot=copilot)), known.get(ref, {}), clock)
        except (RuntimeError, KeyError, ValueError, OSError) as error:
            errors.append(f"next: report {slug} to the Captain: {str(error)[:120]}.")
            continue
        if now["state"] == "OPEN":
            snaps[ref] = now
            out += [facts(ref, now)] + next_for(ref, now)
        elif now["state"] == "MERGED" and "learn" in listed:
            done = subprocess.run([sys.executable, str(SCRIPTS / "observer_check.py"), str(state), slug],
                                  capture_output=True, text=True)
            if done.returncode:
                out += [f"next: keep {slug} out of pr-merge's scan in this pass.", *done.stdout.splitlines()]
            else:
                check = f"python3 {SCRIPTS / 'observer_check.py'} {shlex.quote(str(state))} {slug}"
                out += [f"next: let pr-merge record {slug}.", f"after pr-merge: run `{check}`.",
                        "after pr-merge: do each next: line it prints."]
    if snaps:
        already, _ = record(opts.state, load(opts.state), snaps)
        out += already + [f"next: run `{wait} wait` in the background, unless one is running.",
                          "next: when it exits, do the next: lines it prints."]
    if out or errors:
        print("\n".join(out + errors))
    return 2 if errors else 0


def main(argv=None, look=look, sleep=time.sleep, ask=gh, clock=time.time):
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__, formatter_class=argparse.RawDescriptionHelpFormatter)
    parser.add_argument("--state", type=Path)
    parser.add_argument("command", choices=["add", "check", "wait", "tasks"])
    parser.add_argument("--codex", action="store_true")
    parser.add_argument("--copilot", action="store_true")
    parser.add_argument("args", nargs="*")
    try:
        opts = parser.parse_intermixed_args(argv)
    except SystemExit as stop:
        return 0 if stop.code == 0 else 2
    opts.given = opts.state is not None
    opts.state = opts.state or default_state()
    try:
        if opts.command == "tasks":
            if len(opts.args) != 1:
                print("tasks needs one workflow directory")
                return 2
            return tasks(opts, look, ask, clock)
        if opts.command == "add":
            if not opts.args or not all("/" in r and "#" in r for r in opts.args):
                print("add needs owner/repo#N")
                return 2
            known = load(opts.state)
            first = {}
            for ref in opts.args:
                codex, copilot = read_flags(known, ref, opts.codex, opts.copilot)
                first[ref] = settle(dict(look(ref, with_codex=codex, with_copilot=copilot)), known.get(ref, {}), clock)
            already, seen = record(opts.state, known, first)
            print("\n".join(already + [f"watching {len(seen)} PR(s)"]))
            return 0
        if opts.command == "check":
            changes, rows, _ = sweep(opts.state, look, clock=clock)
            print("\n".join(rows + ([line for line, _ in changes] or ["no change since the last look"])))
            return 0
        every = int(opts.args[0]) if opts.args else 60
        while True:
            nexts = []
            changes, _, watching = sweep(opts.state, look, nexts, clock)
            if any(decisive for _, decisive in changes) or not watching:
                print("\n".join([line for line, _ in changes] + nexts or ["watch list is empty"]))
                return 0
            sleep(every)
    except (RuntimeError, KeyError, ValueError, OSError) as error:
        print(f"configuration error: {error}")
        return 2


if __name__ == "__main__":
    sys.exit(main())

# Validation principles

Check the exact delivered artifact against the approved outcome and relevant
primary evidence. Separate checks actually run, evidence only read, and work
not verified. Observe the selected failure boundary as well as the successful
path when that boundary determines acceptance. At the same candidate, assess both
goal sufficiency and minimal necessity: does the accepted goal work at the selected
profile's depth, and does the without-it observation justify each retained change
or removal? Check that remaining surfaces map to the goal, a named falsifier,
safety boundary or required lifecycle obligation; a deletion earns its place by
the same standard as retention. Use existing evidence, not a new proof harness.

Read every comment the candidate adds. A comment that narrates the change, restates
the code beside it, cites a line number or marks a section is a repair finding.
Measure them with
`python3 <package>/scripts/comment_ratio.py <base> <candidate> --workflow-dir <workflow-dir>`
and report its output. Exit 1 (a ratio above the maximum, or a comment citing task
numbering, review provenance, a PR or issue number or a `file:line`) is a repair
finding returned through feedback; exit 2 is a configuration error that returns to FO.
The citation scan finds the named classes only, so still read every added comment.
When the task has a `## Number guards` section, rerun its `check` at the candidate; exit 1 is a repair
finding returned through feedback and exit 2 is a configuration error that returns to FO.
Validation runs `python3 <package>/scripts/adr_lint.py docs/adr --since <base>`, which
requires every record the candidate added or changed, plus `--require <numbers>` for
each `ADR:` number the task's `## Number guards` reserves and any number the
implementation report names; exit 1 or a missing record returns through the existing
feedback route, and exit 2 is a configuration error that returns to FO.
Read the task's dispatch records (`<task>/dispatch/` in the state checkout) for the
implementation cycles you validate, and run
`python3 <package>/scripts/dispatch_records.py <task folder>`; a missing or incomplete
record (its exit 1), or a requirement in it that traces to no accepted criterion or

When the change alters what a user sees, the evidence includes a screenshot of the
changed screen at the candidate; reading the code or a passing render test is not
seeing it.

For a decisive check, identify evidence that it detects the relevant known error.
Reuse applicable negative or mutation evidence; only when it is missing, run the
smallest counterexample needed. Do not rerun every check or an already-green suite
just to demonstrate this principle.

Every validation stage ends with a minimal acceptance script the Captain can run
himself: three to six steps, five minutes or less, each naming the action and the
expected observation, written for someone outside this session — an exact command

            errors.append(f"{path.name}: 'Surfaces:' has unknown value(s) {', '.join(unknown)}")
        if "none" in surfaces and len(surfaces) > 1:
            errors.append(f"{path.name}: 'Surfaces:' combines 'none' with other values")

    visible = VISIBLE.search(fo)
    if not visible:
        errors.append(f"{path.name}: '## FO alignment' needs a 'Visible change:' line")
    else:
        value = visible.group(1).strip()
        if value.lower() != "none" and "ui" not in surfaces:
            errors.append(f"{path.name}: 'Visible change:' is not 'none' but 'Surfaces:' has no 'ui'")
        if value.lower() == "none" and "ui" in surfaces:
            errors.append(f"{path.name}: 'Visible change: none' contradicts 'ui' in 'Surfaces:'")

    if seed:
        return errors
    if "ui" in surfaces:
        check_ui(path.name, body, path.resolve().parent, errors)
    if "db" in surfaces:
        check_db(path.name, body, errors)
    lines = text.split("\n")
    declared = check_criteria(path.name, lines, errors)
    check_amendments(path.name, lines, declared, errors)
    front = FRONTMATTER.match(text)
    profile, status = (FM_PROFILE.search(front.group(1)), FM_STATUS.search(front.group(1))) if front else (None, None)
    plain = "\n".join(unfenced(lines))
    if profile and status and (profile.group(1), status.group(1)) == ("prod", "ideation"):
        summary = check_security(path, plain, declared, errors)
        if summary and notes is not None:
            notes.append(summary)
    if "ui" in surfaces and status and status.group(1) == "ideation":
        shown = [v.strip() for v in PREVIEW.findall("\n".join(unfenced(body.split("\n"))))]
        summary = check_design_review(path, plain, declared, shown, errors)
        if summary and notes is not None:
            notes.append(summary)
    return errors


def main(argv=None):
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    sub = parser.add_subparsers(dest="command", required=True)
    check = sub.add_parser("check", help="check a task file: FO alignment, surface artifacts, acceptance criteria, Captain amendments")
    check.add_argument("--seed", action="store_true", help="check only the FO-alignment record, before ideation is dispatched")
    check.add_argument("task")
    args = parser.parse_args(argv)
    path = Path(args.task)
    notes = []
    errors = check_task(path, seed=args.seed, notes=notes)
    for error in errors:
        print(error)
    if not errors:
        print(f"{path.name}: {'FO alignment recorded' if args.seed else 'design surfaces presentable'}")
        for note in notes:
            print(note)
    return 1 if errors else 0


if __name__ == "__main__":
    sys.exit(main())
